blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.7
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.7

blocks.text: जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तभेदे तुर्याभोगसम्भवः
blocks.directed: [slowly] जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तभेदे तुर्याभोगसम्भवः

blocks.text: Jāgratsvapnasuṣuptabhede turyābhogasambhavaḥ.
blocks.directed: Jāgratsvapnasuṣuptabhede turyābhogasambhavaḥ.

blocks.text: In the distinctions of waking, dreaming and deep sleep, the experience of the fourth is possible.
blocks.directed: In the distinctions of waking, dreaming and deep sleep, the experience of the fourth is possible.

blocks.text: Turns Out You’re Supposed to Be Awake While You’re Asleep.
blocks.directed: Turns Out You’re Supposed to Be Awake While You’re Asleep.

blocks.text: Now Vasugupta introduces a magnificent idea.
blocks.directed: Now Vasugupta introduces a magnificent idea.

blocks.text: The ordinary person experiences three principal states.
blocks.directed: The ordinary person experiences three principal states.

blocks.text: Jāgrat — waking.
blocks.directed: Jāgrat — waking.

blocks.text: Svapna — dreaming.
blocks.directed: Svapna — dreaming.

blocks.text: Suṣupti — deep sleep.
blocks.directed: Suṣupti — deep sleep.

blocks.text: You wake up.
blocks.directed: You wake up.

blocks.text: There’s a world.
blocks.directed: There’s a world.

blocks.text: You go to sleep.
blocks.directed: You go to sleep.

blocks.text: There’s another world.
blocks.directed: There’s another world.

blocks.text: You fall into dreamless sleep.
blocks.directed: You fall into dreamless sleep.

blocks.text: Apparently, there’s no world at all.
blocks.directed: Apparently, there’s no world at all.

blocks.text: Then you wake up again and go, “Bloody hell, where have eight hours gone?”
blocks.directed: Then you wake up again and go, “Bloody hell, where have eight hours gone?”

blocks.text: But across these changing conditions, the tradition introduces a fourth principle.
blocks.directed: But across these changing conditions, the tradition introduces a fourth principle.

blocks.text: Turya.
blocks.directed: Turya.

blocks.text: Literally, “the fourth”.
blocks.directed: Literally, “the fourth”.

blocks.text: A beautifully understated name for something of such metaphysical significance.
blocks.directed: A beautifully understated name for something of such metaphysical significance.

blocks.text: Didn’t call it the Great Golden Celestial Palace of Eternal Transcendent Consciousness.
blocks.directed: Didn’t call it the Great Golden Celestial Palace of Eternal Transcendent Consciousness.

blocks.text: Just “number four”.
blocks.directed: Just “number four”.

blocks.text: Turya is the underlying nondual consciousness that can be recognised throughout waking, dreaming and deep sleep.
blocks.directed: Turya is the underlying nondual consciousness that can be recognised throughout waking, dreaming and deep sleep.

blocks.text: And this is where the teaching becomes extraordinarily subtle.
blocks.directed: And this is where the teaching becomes extraordinarily subtle.

blocks.text: Because turya is not simply another mental state to be entered after the other three.
blocks.directed: Because turya is not simply another mental state to be entered after the other three.

blocks.text: It is the conscious reality that remains fundamental regardless of their changing contents.
blocks.directed: It is the conscious reality that remains fundamental regardless of their changing contents.

blocks.text: In waking, experiences appear through sensory cognition.
blocks.directed: In waking, experiences appear through sensory cognition.

blocks.text: In dreaming, experiences appear through mental constructions.
blocks.directed: In dreaming, experiences appear through mental constructions.

blocks.text: In deep sleep, differentiated cognition is unmanifest.
blocks.directed: In deep sleep, differentiated cognition is unmanifest.

blocks.text: But from the standpoint of Trika, the ultimate reality of consciousness is not exhausted by any of these states.
blocks.directed: But from the standpoint of Trika, the ultimate reality of consciousness is not exhausted by any of these states.

blocks.text: The accomplished yogi recognises that reality through their transformations.
blocks.directed: The accomplished yogi recognises that reality through their transformations.

blocks.text: Imagine three films being projected onto a screen.
blocks.directed: Imagine three films being projected onto a screen.

blocks.text: An action film.
blocks.directed: An action film.

blocks.text: A romantic comedy.
blocks.directed: A romantic comedy.

blocks.text: And an entirely black film in which nothing happens.
blocks.directed: And an entirely black film in which nothing happens.

blocks.text: The images differ.
blocks.directed: The images differ.

blocks.text: But the screen is not destroyed whenever the film changes.
blocks.directed: But the screen is not destroyed whenever the film changes.

blocks.text: Now take that metaphor carefully: unlike an ordinary screen, Śiva is not an inert support. Śiva is self-aware and free.
blocks.directed: Now take that metaphor carefully: unlike an ordinary screen, Śiva is not an inert support. Śiva is self-aware and free.

blocks.text: The point is the continuity of the underlying reality, not an assertion that your personal waking mind remains fully alert throughout every period of sleep.
blocks.directed: The point is the continuity of the underlying reality, not an assertion that your personal waking mind remains fully alert throughout every period of sleep.

blocks.text: The remarkable claim: Liberation does not require fleeing from ordinary conscious life. The same fundamental reality can be recognised through every mode of experience.
blocks.directed: The remarkable claim: Liberation does not require fleeing from ordinary conscious life. The same fundamental reality can be recognised through every mode of experience.
